# TickerAtlas

> Open reference dataset of stock, ETF and cryptocurrency tickers (US-listed securities from NASDAQ Trader enriched with Yahoo Finance metadata, plus 12,000+ cryptocurrencies from crypti/cryptocurrencies). Published as CSV, JSON, SQLite and text in this repo, and as a static JSON API on GitHub Pages. No API key. Regenerated daily.

Website: https://meridianalgo.github.io/TickerAtlas/
Repository: https://github.com/MeridianAlgo/TickerAtlas
Raw files: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MeridianAlgo/TickerAtlas/main/data/<file>

## Look up a ticker
- Stock or ETF: https://meridianalgo.github.io/TickerAtlas/api/stocks/{slug}.json (e.g. .../api/stocks/AAPL.json)
- Cryptocurrency: https://meridianalgo.github.io/TickerAtlas/api/crypto/{slug}.json (e.g. .../api/crypto/BTC.json)
- slug = ticker, with every character outside A-Z a-z 0-9 . - replaced by "_" + its UTF-8 bytes in uppercase hex ("$MAID" -> "_24MAID"). Case-sensitive. 404 = not in that universe.
- A symbol can be both a stock and a crypto (e.g. SOL). The unique key is id = "<asset_class>:<ticker>".

## Data files (in data/)
- [All_Assets.csv](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MeridianAlgo/TickerAtlas/main/data/All_Assets.csv): every asset. Columns: id, ticker, name, asset_class (stock|etf|crypto|...), exchange, country, sector, source
- [All_Stocks.csv](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MeridianAlgo/TickerAtlas/main/data/All_Stocks.csv): full stock/ETF records. Columns: ticker, company_name, quote_type, exchange, exchange_name, currency, country, sector, industry, website, employees, market_cap, first_trade_date, age_years_since_first_trade, business_summary, listing_source, updated_at_utc
- [All_Stocks.sqlite](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MeridianAlgo/TickerAtlas/main/data/All_Stocks.sqlite): table "stocks", same columns
- [Crypto.csv](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MeridianAlgo/TickerAtlas/main/data/Crypto.csv): ticker, name, asset_class, source
- [Crypto.json](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MeridianAlgo/TickerAtlas/main/data/Crypto.json): {"meta": {...source, source_commit, license}, "crypto": [{"ticker", "name"}]}
- [All_Tickers.txt](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MeridianAlgo/TickerAtlas/main/data/All_Tickers.txt) and [Crypto_Tickers.txt](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MeridianAlgo/TickerAtlas/main/data/Crypto_Tickers.txt): one symbol per line (lines starting with # are comments)

## API & docs
- [API & AI docs](https://meridianalgo.github.io/TickerAtlas/docs.html)
- [OpenAPI spec](https://meridianalgo.github.io/TickerAtlas/openapi.json)
- [Search index](https://meridianalgo.github.io/TickerAtlas/api/index.json): {"fields": [...], "rows": [[...]]}
- [Every ticker and name, tab-separated](https://meridianalgo.github.io/TickerAtlas/llms-full.txt)

## Sources
- US listings: NASDAQ Trader symbol directory https://www.nasdaqtrader.com/trader.aspx?id=symboldirdefs
- Company metadata: Yahoo Finance via yfinance https://github.com/ranaroussi/yfinance
- Cryptocurrencies: crypti/cryptocurrencies (MIT, (c) Michael Wuergler) https://github.com/crypti/cryptocurrencies, generated from the CryptoCompare coin list https://www.cryptocompare.com/

## Notes
- When reading CSVs with pandas, use keep_default_na=False, na_values=[""] so the real ticker "NA" is not read as missing.
- Reference data, not live prices or investment advice. Use the "yahoo_symbol" field from the JSON API to get quotes from a market-data provider.
